title: Mesoscale molecular architecture of the striatum across cell types and adult aging
title_zh: 纹状体中跨细胞类型和成年老龄化的中观分子结构
abstract: The human striatum governs diverse motor, cognitive, and affective behaviors yet lacks the obvious cytoarchitectural boundaries defining functional territories elsewhere in the brain. Using Slide-tags single-nucleus spatial transcriptomics, we profiled 1.1 million cells across 19 postmortem donors to uncover the striatum's spatial organization. These data revealed a consistent subdivision of the striatum into six zones, each defined by molecularly distinct populations of spiny projection neurons (SPNs) and featuring spatially coordinated neuron-astrocyte interaction networks. To determine their structural relevance, we generated a companion mouse spatial atlas that identified four homologous zones that aligned with territories defined by brain-wide afferent projections. Finally, imputing zonal identities onto a 131-donor single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) cohort revealed that dorsal zones exhibit the greatest age-related transcriptional change and that the expression differences defining zonation attenuate with age. This resource establishes a conserved mesoscale spatial framework for the mammalian striatum, linking single-cell molecular identity to structural connectomics and aging.
abstract_zh: 人纹状体调控多种运动、认知和情感行为，但缺乏界定大脑其他功能区的明显细胞构架边界。利用Slide-tags单核空间转录组学，我们对19例尸体捐赠者中的110万个细胞进行了分析，以揭示纹状体的空间组织。数据显示，纹状体一致地划分为六个区域，每个区域由分子特征不同的棘状投射神经元（SPN）群体定义，并呈现空间协调的神经元—星形胶质细胞相互作用网络。为确定其结构相关性，我们构建了配套的鼠类空间图谱，鉴定出四个同源区域，其位置与全脑输入投射所界定的区域相符。最后，将区域身份推测至包含131名捐赠者的单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）队列中，发现背侧区域表现出最大的与年龄相关的转录变化，且界定分区特征的表达差异随年龄增长而减弱。该资源为哺乳动物纹状体建立了保守的中观空间框架，将单细胞分子身份与结构连接组学和老龄化联系起来。
